info.title: EdgeFetch Hub API
info.summary: Self-hosted web scraping, search, browser automation, and MCP coordinator for AI agents.
info.description: EdgeFetch Hub coordinates polite outbound-only Go worker nodes (HTTP/2, Headless Chromium, Poppler PDF/OCR, and 49+ keyless site adapters) with strict RFC 9309 robots.txt and Content-Signal compliance, D1 FTS5 hybrid search, R2 content-addressed artifacts, self-hosted OAuth 2.1 PKCE, and Streamable HTTP Model Context Protocol (`POST /mcp`).

servers.description: EdgeFetch Canonical Specification Origin (replace with your self-hosted Hub URL)

tags.name: Discovery
tags.description: Health checks, OpenAPI 3.1.0 schema, RFC 9421 Web Bot Auth directory, and OAuth 2.1 metadata.

tags.name: System
tags.description: Hub capabilities, keyless site adapters, per-host health telemetry, stored artifacts, and worker fleet.

tags.name: Scraping & Extraction
tags.description: Polite URL-to-Markdown scraping, multi-URL batch scraping, BM25 passage extraction, and tab clipping.

tags.name: Browser Automation
tags.description: Sandboxed Headless Chromium interaction with dial-time SSRF isolation and session persistence.

tags.name: Crawl & Map
tags.description: Fast sitemap/llms.txt URL discovery and asynchronous breadth-first site crawling.

tags.name: Search & Collections
tags.description: Edge-first web search waterfall (Serper/Tavily/Brave/SearXNG) and private D1 FTS5 collection search.

tags.name: Vertical Intelligence
tags.description: Normalized multi-ATS job search/verification and polite full-store Shopify/WooCommerce catalog diffing.

tags.name: Autonomous Agent
tags.description: Multi-step web research and structured JSON extraction powered by BYO-LLM or local Ollama.

tags.name: Coordinator & MCP
tags.description: Low-level multi-URL coordinator dispatch (`POST /fetch`) and Streamable HTTP MCP (`POST /mcp`).

tags.name: Compatibility

get.description: Returns HTTP 200 `{ "ok": true }` without authentication for uptime monitors and container health checks.
Returns this OpenAPI 3.1.0 document with permissive CORS (`Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`) for 1-click import into ChatGPT Actions, OpenWebUI, Dify, n8n, Postman, and Scalar.
Declares EdgeFetch User-Agent, strict RFC 9309 robots.txt and Content-Signal (`ai-input`) policies, anti-bot challenge halt guarantee, and RFC 9421 Web Bot Auth key directory link.

bearerAuth.description: Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <token>` using your Hub `CALLER_TOKEN`, scoped `MCP_TOKEN`, or an OAuth 2.1 access token (`X-API-Key` is also accepted).

oauth2Pkce.description: Self-hosted OAuth 2.1 Authorization Code flow with mandatory `S256` PKCE (`code_challenge_method=S256`) and RFC 7591 Dynamic Client Registration (`POST /oauth/register`).

scopes.crawl:read: Read capabilities, keyless site adapters, host health, connected worker status, stored R2 artifacts, and search indexes.
scopes.crawl:fetch: Execute polite outbound scrapes, crawls, URL maps, browser interactions, job/catalog extractions, and autonomous agent runs.

schema.description: Optional JSON Schema object when type="json".

formats.description: Desired output formats (string format names or { type: "json", schema } for structured extraction).

renderMode.description: "auto" (default) automatically switches thin/SPA pages to headless Chromium on edgefetch_fat nodes; "always" or "browser" forces Chromium.

waitForMs.description: Extra JS settle wait in ms when rendering.

waitSelector.description: Optional CSS selector to wait for when rendering.

maxPages.description: Max PDF pages to extract via Poppler pdftotext / PyMuPDF + Tesseract OCR.

ocr.description: PDF OCR mode via PyMuPDF + Tesseract 5.5.0: "auto" OCRs scanned/image-only PDFs; "always" forces OCR on image-based tables.

onlyMainContent.description: Strip nav/footer/aside chrome and isolate main/article content.

includeTags.description: Optional HTML tag/ID/class selectors (e.g. ["article", "#content", ".post-body"]) to keep exclusively.

excludeTags.description: Optional HTML tag/ID/class selectors (e.g. [".comments", "#cookie-banner", "aside"]) to remove before Markdown conversion.

includeImages.description: Include content images >=100px (set false to strip all images and inline ![...] tags).

maxChars.description: Optional max Markdown character limit (default 100000 on MCP; truncates cleanly at paragraph/word boundary and returns markdownArtifactId + nextOffset for lossless paging via read_artifact).

discoverLlmsTxt.description: Check /llms.txt and upgrade to companion .md when available.

preferOriginMarkdown.description: Set false to negotiate text/html instead of text/markdown on origins supporting Markdown for Agents.

maxAgeMs.description: Serve cached verified Markdown if fetched within maxAgeMs.

redactPii.description: Redact emails, phone numbers, and SSNs.

checkPromptInjection.description: $0 prompt-injection guard: fails fast with 403 SCRAPE_PROMPT_INJECTION_DETECTED when malicious override directives are found.

mobile.description: Emulate 390x844 mobile viewport in headless browser.

actions.description: Optional inline browser actions (wait, click, write, fill, press, scroll, screenshot, scrape, executeJavascript, pdf).

parsers.description: Optional PDF/image parser controls (e.g. [{ type: "pdf", mode: "auto", pages: true, pageMarkers: true }] or [] for raw base64).

query.description: Optional focus query to rerank relevant passages.

jsonFilter.description: Optional record filter for JSON array responses (e.g. `title~"Forward Deployed"` or `id=abc123`), emitting 1 chunk per record.

collectionId.description: Optional FTS5 collection ID to index the verified Markdown into.

waybackFallback.description: Opt-in Internet Archive Wayback fallback strictly on 5xx or network-unreachable link rot (never used on robots.txt, 401/403/429, or anti-bot challenges).

spaFallback.description: When CRAWL4AI_API_URL or FIRECRAWL_API_URL/KEY is configured on the Hub, ethically falls back on heavy/unhydrated SPAs or missing local browser nodes (never used on robots.txt, 403/429, or challenges).

site.description: Optional standby site ID when target="agent".

urls.description: 1..20 public https:// URLs to extract from.

query.description: Focus query used to BM25-rank the top chunks per source.

jsonFilter.description: Optional record filter for JSON array responses (e.g. `title~"Forward Deployed"` or `id=abc123`), emitting 1 chunk per record.

renderMode.description: "auto" (default) upgrades thin scripted pages to headless Chromium; "always" or "browser" forces Chromium.

maxAgeMs.description: Serve cached verified Markdown if fetched within maxAgeMs.

redactPii.description: Redact emails, phone numbers, and SSNs.

collectionId.description: Optional FTS5 collection ID to index extracted pages into.

waybackFallback.description: Opt-in Internet Archive Wayback fallback strictly on 5xx or network-unreachable link rot (never used on robots.txt, 401/403/429, or anti-bot challenges).

site.description: Optional standby site ID when target="agent".

url.description: Initial public https:// URL (omit when resuming/closing sessionId).

sessionId.description: Composite sessionId returned from a prior interact call with keepSession=true.

keepSession.description: Keep the incognito browser tab open for follow-up interact calls.

closeSession.description: Close the retained browser session after this turn.

url.description: Root public https:// URL of the site.

search.description: Optional keyword filter to rank/filter matching URLs.

includeOutsidePath.description: When false (default), restricts discovered URLs to the root URL path prefix when url has a subpath.

query.description: Search query (1..500 chars). Supports site:domain.com for $0 HAOS edge-map discovery.

mode.description: "waterfall" (default) runs Serper alone first and calls SearXNG/Brave only if Serper returns <3 hits; "serper" skips Brave completely; "rrf" fuses active providers in parallel.

providers.description: Optional explicit provider allowlist (e.g. ["serper"] or ["serper", "searxng"] to never call Brave).

max_age_ms.description: SERP cache max age in ms (default 86400000 = 24h; 0 bypasses cache).

include_raw_content.description: Fetch & chunk top results politely via EdgeFetch HAOS agents.

collections.description: Optional private SEARCH D1 collection IDs to fuse.

collectionId.description: Optional single private SEARCH D1 collection ID to fuse.

McpTool_ListAgentsInput.title: List Connected Crawler Agents (MCP list_agents)
McpTool_ListAgentsInput.description: List connected Home Assistant OS / EdgeFetch standby crawler agents (LITE vs FAT browser/PDF tiers), CPU architectures, job counters, and active host-affinity pins.

McpTool_FetchUrlInput.title: Fetch Public HTTPS URL (MCP fetch_url)
McpTool_FetchUrlInput.description: Fetch a public HTTPS URL politely through the EdgeFetch coordinator (enforcing robots.txt, per-host rate limits, SSRF blocks, and returning DNS/TLS/TTFB phase timings plus response content).

kind.description: Optional response kind ("page" for HTML, "text" for sitemaps/XML/RSS/Markdown/plain text, "json" for JSON APIs, "feed" for Shopify /products.json). Omit to auto-detect from URL.

accept.description: Optional Accept media type override (e.g. "text/html" on kind="page" to request HTML instead of text/markdown; for kind="text", defaults from URL extension).

target.description: Execution tier ("auto" = load-balance across remote HAOS nodes and reach out via Cloudflare only on 429, "agent", or "container").

site.description: Optional standby site ID to pin (e.g. "site-arm64", "site-x86", "site-win-vm").

includeBody.description: Include response body preview in tool output.

maxBytes.description: Maximum inline preview size in chars/bytes (256..16777216). Full untruncated body is always stored in R2 and readable via read_artifact.

ifNoneMatch.description: Optional ETag for conditional 304 Not Modified checks.

ifModifiedSince.description: Optional Last-Modified timestamp for conditional 304 checks.

McpTool_FetchBatchInput.title: Batch Fetch Public HTTPS URLs (MCP fetch_batch)
McpTool_FetchBatchInput.description: Politely fetch up to 25 public HTTPS URLs in one coordinated batch with per-host serialization, positive dwell jitter, robots.txt checks, and phase timing.

urls.description: 1 to 25 public https:// URLs to fetch.

kind.description: Optional kind applied to every URL; omit to auto-detect per URL (HTML -> "page", RSS/XML/Markdown/txt -> "text", .json -> "json").

accept.description: For kind "text" only; applies to every URL. Default: picked from each URL.

site.description: Optional standby site ID when target="agent".

pauseJitterMs.description: Random positive jitter added to pauseMs.

includeBody.description: Set true to include truncated body previews per URL.

previewBytes.description: Max inline body preview chars per URL when includeBody=true (default 3072; full body stays in R2 via read_artifact).

McpTool_ScrapeInput.title: Scrape URL to Markdown & Metadata (MCP scrape)
McpTool_ScrapeInput.description: Scrape a public HTTPS URL into clean main-content Markdown, metadata, links, images, branding, changes diff, and /llms.txt + companion .md discovery (with verified META D1 + R2 maxAgeMs caching and optional Chromium rendering).

schema.description: Optional JSON Schema object when type="json".

formats.description: Desired output formats (string format names or { type: "json", schema } for structured extraction).

renderMode.description: "auto" (default) automatically switches thin/SPA pages to headless Chromium on edgefetch_fat nodes; "always" or "browser" forces Chromium.

waitForMs.description: Extra JS settle wait in ms when rendering.

waitSelector.description: Optional CSS selector to wait for when rendering.

maxPages.description: Max PDF pages to extract via Poppler pdftotext / PyMuPDF + Tesseract OCR.

ocr.description: PDF OCR mode via PyMuPDF + Tesseract 5.5.0: "auto" OCRs scanned/image-only PDFs; "always" forces OCR on image-based tables.

onlyMainContent.description: Strip nav/footer/aside chrome and isolate main/article content.

includeTags.description: Optional HTML tag/ID/class selectors (e.g. ["article", "#content", ".post-body"]) to keep exclusively.

excludeTags.description: Optional HTML tag/ID/class selectors (e.g. [".comments", "#cookie-banner", "aside"]) to remove before Markdown conversion.

includeImages.description: Include content images >=100px (set false to strip all images and inline ![...] tags).

maxChars.description: Optional max Markdown character limit (default 100000 on MCP; truncates cleanly at paragraph/word boundary and returns markdownArtifactId + nextOffset for lossless paging via read_artifact).

discoverLlmsTxt.description: Check /llms.txt and upgrade to companion .md when available.

preferOriginMarkdown.description: Set false to negotiate text/html instead of text/markdown on origins supporting Markdown for Agents.

maxAgeMs.description: Serve cached verified Markdown if fetched within maxAgeMs.

redactPii.description: Redact emails, phone numbers, and SSNs.

checkPromptInjection.description: $0 prompt-injection guard: fails fast with 403 SCRAPE_PROMPT_INJECTION_DETECTED when malicious override directives are found.

mobile.description: Emulate 390x844 mobile viewport in headless browser.

actions.description: Optional inline browser actions (wait, click, write, fill, press, scroll, screenshot, scrape, executeJavascript, pdf).

parsers.description: Optional PDF/image parser controls (e.g. [{ type: "pdf", mode: "auto", pages: true, pageMarkers: true }] or [] for raw base64).

query.description: Optional focus query to rerank relevant passages.

jsonFilter.description: Optional record filter for JSON array responses (e.g. `title~"Forward Deployed"` or `id=abc123`), emitting 1 chunk per record.

collectionId.description: Optional FTS5 collection ID to index the verified Markdown into.

waybackFallback.description: Opt-in Internet Archive Wayback fallback strictly on 5xx or network-unreachable link rot (never used on robots.txt, 401/403/429, or anti-bot challenges).

spaFallback.description: When CRAWL4AI_API_URL or FIRECRAWL_API_URL/KEY is configured on the Hub, ethically falls back on heavy/unhydrated SPAs or missing local browser nodes (never used on robots.txt, 403/429, or challenges).

site.description: Optional standby site ID when target="agent".

McpTool_ExtractInput.title: Extract Focused Passages from URLs (MCP extract)
McpTool_ExtractInput.description: Extract clean Markdown and BM25 query-ranked chunks across 1..20 public HTTPS URLs in one polite batch (with optional verified maxAgeMs cache and FTS5 collection indexing).

urls.description: 1..20 public https:// URLs to extract from.

query.description: Focus query used to BM25-rank the top chunks per source.

jsonFilter.description: Optional record filter for JSON array responses (e.g. `title~"Forward Deployed"` or `id=abc123`), emitting 1 chunk per record.

renderMode.description: "auto" (default) upgrades thin scripted pages to headless Chromium; "always" or "browser" forces Chromium.

maxAgeMs.description: Serve cached verified Markdown if fetched within maxAgeMs.

redactPii.description: Redact emails, phone numbers, and SSNs.

collectionId.description: Optional FTS5 collection ID to index extracted pages into.

waybackFallback.description: Opt-in Internet Archive Wayback fallback strictly on 5xx or network-unreachable link rot (never used on robots.txt, 401/403/429, or anti-bot challenges).

spaFallback.description: When CRAWL4AI_API_URL or FIRECRAWL_API_URL/KEY is configured on the Hub, ethically falls back on heavy/unhydrated SPAs or missing local browser nodes (never used on robots.txt, 403/429, or challenges).

site.description: Optional standby site ID when target="agent".

McpTool_MapInput.title: Map Site URLs (MCP map)
McpTool_MapInput.description: Discover URLs on a site rapidly and politely via robots.txt Sitemap:, sitemap.xml / .xml.gz, /llms.txt, and homepage links, with optional search filter.

url.description: Root public https:// URL of the site.

search.description: Optional keyword filter to rank/filter matching URLs.

includeOutsidePath.description: When false (default), restricts discovered URLs to the root URL path prefix when url has a subpath.

site.description: Optional standby site ID when target="agent".

McpTool_CrawlInput.title: Async Site Crawl (Start / Status / Cancel) (MCP crawl)
McpTool_CrawlInput.description: Start an async multi-page breadth-first site crawl (with robots.txt, includePaths/excludePaths, SEARCH D1 FTS5 indexing, and HMAC webhooks), OR pass crawlId to poll status / cancel.

url.description: Root public https:// URL to start crawling (omit when checking/cancelling crawlId).

crawlId.description: Existing crawl ID (`crw_...`) to check status or cancel.

cancel.description: Set true with crawlId to cancel a running crawl.

collectionId.description: Optional SEARCH D1 collection ID to index crawled pages into.

McpTool_SearchInput.title: Search Web & Crawled Collections (MCP search)
McpTool_SearchInput.description: Edge-first web & collection search: queries private SEARCH D1 FTS5 + HAOS edge-map (/llms.txt & sitemap.xml on site: queries) + 24h SERP cache + Serper (Google) waterfall (calling SearXNG/Brave only on <3 hits), with optional live HAOS page extraction.

query.description: Search query (1..500 chars). Supports site:domain.com for $0 HAOS edge-map discovery.

mode.description: "waterfall" (default) runs Serper alone first and calls SearXNG/Brave only if Serper returns <3 hits; "serper" skips Brave completely; "rrf" fuses active providers in parallel.

providers.description: Optional explicit provider allowlist (e.g. ["serper"] or ["serper", "searxng"] to never call Brave).

max_age_ms.description: SERP cache max age in ms (default 86400000 = 24h; 0 bypasses cache).

include_raw_content.description: Fetch & chunk top results politely via EdgeFetch HAOS agents.

collections.description: Optional private SEARCH D1 collection IDs to fuse.

collectionId.description: Optional single private SEARCH D1 collection ID to fuse.

McpTool_SearchCollectionInput.title: Search Indexed Collection (D1 FTS5) (MCP search_collection)
McpTool_SearchCollectionInput.description: Search a private SEARCH D1 FTS5 collection populated by crawl, scrape, or extract (e.g. collectionId="default" or a crawlId `crw_...`) with BM25 ranking and snippets.

collectionId.description: Target collection ID (`default` or a custom / `crw_...` collectionId).

query.description: Keyword search query matched safely against FTS5 chunks.

McpTool_InteractInput.title: Interact with Page in Sandboxed Headless Browser (MCP interact)
McpTool_InteractInput.description: Drive a sandboxed headless Chromium session on an edgefetch_fat (browser-v1) node (click, fill, press, scroll, wait, PNG screenshots) with SSRF CONNECT isolation, robots.txt pre-checks, and automatic stop on anti-bot challenges.

url.description: Initial public https:// URL (omit when resuming/closing sessionId).

sessionId.description: Composite sessionId returned from a prior interact call with keepSession=true.

keepSession.description: Keep the incognito browser tab open for follow-up interact calls.

closeSession.description: Close the retained browser session after this turn.

McpTool_ReadArtifactInput.title: Read Paged Crawl Artifact (MCP read_artifact)
McpTool_ReadArtifactInput.description: Read a slice of a stored R2 artifact by artifactId (64-char hex blobSha256 for raw fetch bodies, or md:<sha256> / format="markdown" for derived scrape Markdown) using character offset + limit paging.

artifactId.description: 64-character hex blobSha256 (from fetch_url/fetch_batch/scrape) OR md:<sha256> (markdownArtifactId from scrape).

format.description: Optional slice format ("raw" default for blobSha256; "markdown" reads derived clean Markdown when available).

offset.description: Character offset to start reading from.

limit.description: Max characters to return in this page.

strictPay.description: When true and minBase is set, drop jobs with unlisted pay instead of keeping them with payUnknown: true.

McpTool_FindExtractorsInput.title: Search Built-In Keyless Site Adapters (MCP find_extractors)
McpTool_FindExtractorsInput.description: On-demand dynamic search across EdgeFetch’s 49+ keyless built-in site/API adapters (SEC EDGAR, YC, Polymarket, Ashby/Greenhouse/Lever/Workday/Workable/Gem/Rippling ATS, arXiv, OpenAlex, DOI/Crossref, ClinicalTrials, openFDA, PubChem, Socrata, CKAN, ArcGIS, Legistar, USAspending, NIST NVD CVEs, npm, PyPI, Crates, Shopify, etc.) without context bloat.

query.description: Provider name, domain, or data topic (e.g. "SEC 10-K", "CVE", "clinical trials").

McpTool_CatalogInput.description: Polite, single-host sequential full-store e-commerce catalog extraction (Shopify /products.json and WooCommerce Store API) with robots.txt + Content-Signal compliance, 3-strikes 429 cooldown, shrink guard, variant-level snapshot diffing, and paged record filtering via catalogId.
